map.因为行首空格（缩进）也属于空白字符：若选择了「合并连续空格为单个」或「去除每行首: Because leading spaces (indentation) are whitespace too: with "Merge consecutive spaces" or "Trim leading/trailing whitespace" enabled, code indentation and list hierarchy are removed. map.先按换行（兼容 \\n、\\r\\n、\\r 三种）把原文切分为原始行，统计原始:
It first splits the text into original lines on line breaks (supporting 
, 
, and ), counting the original characters and the number of original blank lines (empty after removing whitespace). It then applies four toggles in order: trim leading/trailing whitespace per line; filter out lines that are empty after removing whitespace; collapse runs of spaces and tabs within each line into a single space. The result is joined with 
, and if trailing newline is checked, all trailing newlines are removed and one newline is appended. Statistics output the processed line count, the removed blank line count (original blank lines − processed blank lines), and the processed character count; whitespace details count spaces, tabs, CRLFs, standalone CRs (a  not followed by 
), and standalone LFs (a 
 not preceded by ). The line-by-line preview takes the first min(5, max(original lines, processed lines)) lines and shows the original and processed text side by side
